stories.summary: Epoch AI and Anthropic independently found the same thing: current AI models like GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 can run experiments but lack scientific self-criticism and genuine creative thinking. At best, Sol reached 15 percent of the human reference score,
points: Epoch AI and Anthropic independently found the same thing: current AI models like GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 can run experiments but lack scientific self-criticism an
At best, Sol reached 15 percent of the human reference score, and even that came from methods researchers already knew.
The models' biggest weakness is still their inability to critically question their own results.

stories.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top s
points: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview.
The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V.
Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits.
